# Let's Hack It

> Lucas Teske's public technical blog about electronics, hardware hacking, software-defined radio, satellites, reverse engineering, and security research.

All published content and read-only discovery resources are available without authentication. Prefer the Markdown representation advertised by each HTML page when one is available.

## Primary content

- [Latest articles](https://lucasteske.dev/): Recent English-language posts and the article archive.
- [Portuguese edition](https://lucasteske.dev/pt/): Portuguese translations and original posts.
- [Satellite projects](https://lucasteske.dev/satcom-projects): Satellite reception and decoding projects.
- [Electronics calculators](https://lucasteske.dev/calculators): Public electronics calculators and reference tools.
- [Presentations](https://lucasteske.dev/my-presentations): Technical talks and presentation material.
- [About Lucas Teske](https://lucasteske.dev/about): Author identity and background.

## Machine-readable resources

- [XML sitemap](https://lucasteske.dev/sitemap_index.xml): Complete page discovery.
- [API catalog](https://lucasteske.dev/.well-known/api-catalog): RFC 9727 catalog of public APIs.
- [OpenAPI description](https://lucasteske.dev/openapi.json): Contract for the read-only search index.
- [Search API documentation](https://lucasteske.dev/api/search/): Human-readable API usage.
- [Search index](https://lucasteske.dev/search.json): Public article metadata.

## Agent guidance

- [Authentication status](https://lucasteske.dev/auth.md): Anonymous access and credential guidance.
- [Crawler and AI-use policy](https://lucasteske.dev/robots.txt): Crawl permissions, sitemap location, and content-use signals.
- [TDM reservation declaration](https://lucasteske.dev/.well-known/tdmrep.json): Text and data mining rights are not reserved for public content.

This site does not expose an A2A or MCP task service. The public Search API is a read-only article index, not an autonomous agent interface.

## Content representations

HTML content pages advertise an alternate Markdown representation with a standard `rel="alternate"` link whose media type is `text/markdown`. The corresponding `.md` URL is suitable for agents that do not need presentation markup.
